GitHub Actions workflow for unit, script, fuzz, test-vector, solcap, and integration tests.

# Purpose
This GitHub Actions workflow runs the project test suite on several machine targets and compiler setups. It defines three test cases in a matrix: `linux_gcc_x86_64`, `linux_clang_icelake`, and `native`, and it assigns each case the build targets, compiler version, extra build options, and test flags that it needs. The workflow builds the selected targets, then runs unit tests, script tests, fuzz tests, and, on the `native` case, test-vector, solcap, and integration tests. It also sets concurrency rules to cancel older runs for the same branch or pull request, and it uses shared actions to install dependencies, prepare huge pages, and set CPU state before test execution.
